register.name: SYDEREP
register.numberFormat: IDU/UIN — unique identifier issued per EPR scheme
register.notes: The UIN must be displayed on marketplaces / in general terms of sale. Registration happens through the PRO, which reports to SYDEREP and triggers issuance of the IDU.

pro.ecoModulation: CITEO eco-modulation: bonuses ±15–20%, maluses up to 50–100% (assuro.io, unverified).

notes: Indicative aluminium fee ~€186.5/t (netzerocompare, 2025) — unverified. Pull the current CITEO tariff PDF in the verification batch.
